title: One business setup contains many named actions [pack → capabilities]
alt: ClinicOS is the parent pack; clinic.find_times and clinic.book are two of its registered capabilities, alongside agents, Tables, screens and jobs.

title: One capability registry feeds the catalogue and the runtime
alt: A binding enters capabilities/implementations.ts, which supplies both generated entry.json metadata and the deployed invocation handler map.

title: Find an exact slot, then request its booking
alt: The clinic.find_times result supplies exact appointment fields to clinic.book, which previews, awaits approval, rechecks and confirms the provider outcome.
